cases.business_problem: Manual forms and manager-HR coordination caused errors and poor experience when promotions or assignments changed.

cases.business_problem: Food already on shelves can expire unsold and become waste.
cases.business_context: Albert Heijn stores with electronic shelf labels.

cases.business_problem: Customer emails could take a working day to answer and self-hosted generation had cost and response quality problems as volume rose.

cases.business_problem: High-volume invoices and shipping forms require slow manual entry and are vulnerable to human errors.
cases.target_task: Extract fields from trade finance documents
cases.business_context: Hong Leong Bank trade operations, multilingual financial documents.

cases.business_problem: Document review must identify details that could expose the bank to regulatory or financial risks.
